cases.name: Kaycee Wofford
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was raised in Buffalo and Mexia and had attended Buffalo High School before moving to Wichita Falls. Kaycee was a social young lady who most enjoyed being around others. She had a knack for making people laugh and enjoyed talking to people. She also had a talent for painting and liked to cook. Kaycee and her unborn daughter, Izabella, were taken too soon from this earth on June 8, 2022 in Wichita Falls, Texas."
